preconditions.description: Input integers n and k satisfy 1 <= k < n <= 10^5.

preconditions.expression: len(parts) == 2 and all(x.isdigit() for x in parts)
preconditions.description: The input line contains exactly two space-separated positive integers.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.
The output integers form a valid permutation of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: len({abs(out_vals[i] - out_vals[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)}) == k
postconditions.description: The set of absolute differences between adjacent elements in the output permutation has exactly k distinct values.
